Same organizer and number, different concert
title: Merrow Ensemble prepares Glass Tide
body:
Merrow Ensemble is staging its Glass Tide concert.

The hall for that concert has 84 seats.
sources: merrow.example
Merrow Ensemble program. For the Copper Rain concert the hall has 84 seats.

description: Same owner, different facility and different number
title: Tern Cooperative opens Foxglove Hall
body:
Tern Cooperative opened Foxglove Hall.

Its seating capacity is 52.
sources: tern.example
Tern Cooperative properties register. Juniper Hall has a seating capacity of 76.

description: Different counts for the same named facility
title: Mallow Studio opens its Ash Gallery
body:
Mallow Studio opened its Ash Gallery.

The gallery has 55 seats.
sources: mallow.example
Mallow Studio venue register. The seating capacity of our Ash Gallery is 72.

description: An independent publisher confirms the same named facility
title: Larkspur Trust opens Birch Pavilion
body:
Larkspur Trust opened Birch Pavilion.

The pavilion has 63 seats.
sources: westhaven.example
Westhaven Municipal Office venue register. Birch Pavilion, operated by Larkspur Trust, has 63 seats.

description: An irrelevant passage comes before a relevant one
title: Umbra Arts opens its Reed Theatre
body:
Umbra Arts opened Reed Theatre.

The theatre seats 46.
sources: umbra.example
Umbra Arts venue handbook. The seating capacity of Flint Theatre is 88.
reed.example
Reed Theatre fact sheet. Our theatre, operated by Umbra Arts, has 46 seats.

description: The same class has multiple sessions
title: Paper Ferry announces its Saturday printmaking class
body:
Paper Ferry offers a printmaking class each Friday and Saturday.

The Saturday class starts at 10 a.m.
sources: paperferry.example
Paper Ferry weekly programme. The Friday printmaking class starts at 9 a.m.

description: Independent listing gives a conflicting time for the exact performance
title: Nettle Players stages Lantern Map on Thursday
body:
Nettle Players is staging Lantern Map at Rill Hall on Thursday.

That performance starts at 6 p.m.
sources: rillgazette.example
Rill Gazette arts desk. Thursday's Lantern Map performance by Nettle Players at Rill Hall starts at 8 p.m.

description: An agreeing time for the named meeting and a different time for another meeting
title: Fallow reading circle hosts a night at Alder Mill
body:
The Fallow reading circle meets at Alder Mill on Wednesday.

The meeting starts at 7 p.m.
sources: fallow.example
Fallow reading circle calendar. Our Wednesday meeting at Alder Mill starts at 7 p.m.
aldermill.example
Alder Mill calendar. Wednesday's Pebble Choir rehearsal starts at 8 p.m.

description: A relevant passage gives only a date and another project's passage gives a capacity
title: Snowbank Arts opens Lake Loom Studio
body:
Snowbank Arts is opening Lake Loom Studio.

The studio seats 32.
sources: snowbank.example
Snowbank Arts opening notice. Lake Loom Studio opens on 4 June.
cedarloft.example
Cedar Loft Studio facility sheet. The seating capacity of Cedar Loft Studio is 48.
